title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Thomas Fidone II inactive for Thursday Night Football
items.desc: Thomas Fidone II is inactive for Thursday Night Football against the Commanders.
items.impact: With multiple healthy tight ends ahead of him, this is hardly surprising. He will look to next week to find his way back onto the field.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Paulson Adebo inactive for TNF
items.desc: Paulson Adebo is inactive for the Giants Thursday Night matchup against the Commanders.
items.impact: Adebo played against the Eagles on Sunday, but won't be out there tonight due to a healthy scratch designation. It's a tough blow to one of the more promising IDP assets from a couple of years ago.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was able to return to practice on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice with an ankle issue. He was still not a full participant, but fantasy managers should expect him to suit up and play in Week 10 still, barring any unforeseen setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Robert Hainsey (concussion) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Robert Hainsey (concussion) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hainsey is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday, which is a good sign for his Week 10 availability. We should know more about his official game status sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle) limited Thursday
items.desc: Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Cleveland was limited for Thursday's practice due to a pair of lower-body injuries that he's dealing with. He still looks likely to play in Week 10, but Jacksonville's offensive front will be weaker than usual in the off-chance that he's ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: A hand injury left Rodriguez limited at a second-straight practice on Thursday, but it doesn't seem to be a major issue and isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 10. He could be worth streaming this week if Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is unable to suit up for the Jaguars.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) doesn't practice again Thursday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) did not take part in Jacksonville's practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Tuten has now missed both of Jacksonville's practices to start the week. Friday's injury report should give us some clarity on if he's trending to play on Sunday or not, but either way fantasy managers should be preparing for the possibility that he will be sidelined or limited in Week 10, especially with Jacksonville likely not needing him in an easy matchup against the Titans this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back) full participant Thursday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring/back) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Overshown seems ready to make his return to the lineup in Week 10, as he was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after missing last week's game with a pair of injuries. His return would be timely for the Cowboys ahead of a tough matchup against the 49ers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Turpin was again limited at practice on Thursday due to the same injury to his ribs that he has been managing recently. He will see more work than usual if he's active this week and George Pickens (hamstring) is ruled out for the Cowboys.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) was absent from Dallas' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Porter is trending towards missing another game in Week 10, as he has been a non-participant at both of Dallas' practices to start the week. His absence would be less than ideal this week ahead of a big matchup against the high-powered 49ers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Pickens (hamstring) limited again Thursday
items.desc: George Pickens (hamstring) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The Cowboys were without Pickens last week due to a hamstring injury, and it left him limited for another practice on Thursday as well. He could be sidelined for another game on Sunday, but we won't know his official game status until sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Mingo (ankle/foot) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Jonathan Mingo (ankle/foot) missed Dallas' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mingo has now been sidelined for two-straight practices to start the week and seems likely to be sidelined in Week 10 as a result. Look for Ryan Flournoy to benefit from his absence if the veteran is ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Harrison is trending the wrong way for Week 10, as he was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by a hamstring issue on Wednesday. His absence this week would clear the way for Xavier Hutchinson and Kayshon Boutte to see more opportunities on Houston's offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Woody Marks (knee) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Woody Marks (knee) did not take part in Houston's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Marks suffered a knee injury in practice on Wednesday and wasn't able to practice on Thursday as a result. It looks like he's trending towards missing Week 10's matchup against the Browns, and if David Montgomery (groin) is also ruled out, fantasy managers should expect Emari Demercado and Dare Ogunbowale to both see more opportunities in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Blankenship was sidelined for Week 9's game, but it looks like he's going to be back in Week 10, as he was able to log a full practice session on Thursday. His return would offer a great boost to Houston's defense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brevin Jordan (finger/foot) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Brevin Jordan (finger/foot) was sidelined at Houston's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jordan was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's dealing with two injuries right now, and it looks likely that he will be sidelined in Week 10 as a result. His absence would possibly lead to more work for Foster Moreau against the Browns.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Montgomery was able to log a limited practice session on Thursday after being a non-participant on Wednesday. He could make his return to the lineup in Week 10, which would be timely with Woody Marks (knee) trending towards being sidelined against the Browns this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Dell was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday due to a pair of injuries. He should be a full go for Week 10 and will look to continue building on the success that he has been having lately.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) considered limited Thursday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) was considered limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran made his return to practice on Thursday after being sidelined by a knee issue on Wednesday. He was limited for this practice, so he's not out of the weeds entirely. At this point he's expected to play on Sunday, however, which is good news for Cleveland's offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Denzel Ward (quad) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Denzel Ward (quad) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Ward was limited at another practice on Thursday as he continues to manage a quad issue of some kind. He will likely play through it in Week 10, but in the off-chance that he doesn't, Cleveland's secondary will be significantly weaker than usual ahead of a matchup against a red-hot Texans' offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tytus Howard (knee) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Tytus Howard (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As usual, Howard was left limited at practice by a nagging knee issue on Thursday. It doesn't look likely to affect his availability for Week 10, but we won't know for sure until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Fannin was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still managing a groin issue, but it doesn't seem to be a major threat to his Week 10 availability. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him if he's active this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cade Mays (ankle) sidelined for Week 10
items.desc: Cade Mays (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: The Lions will be without their starting center on Sunday as he continues to nurse an ankle injury of some kind. His next chance to play will come in Week 11 against the Buccaneers, and Detroit's offensive front will be weaker than usual until then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Kerby Joseph (knee) won't play in Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Joseph won't be available to play on Sunday. He has yet to make his season debut for the Lions, and although it appears that he's getting close, it won't come this week. D.J. Reed (hip) is also going to be sidelined, which is less than ideal for Detroit's defense ahead of a matchup against the Patriots on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: D.J. Reed Jr. (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: Reed won't be available to play on Sunday. He's recovering from a hip issue right now, and the team wants to give him adequate time off in order to rest and make a full recovery. Detroit's secondary will be weaker with him and Kerby Joseph (knee) both out against the Patriots.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Goff (chest) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Jared Goff (chest) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Goff was limited on Wednesday due to a chest issue of some kind, but he was able to log a full practice on Thursday and should be good to go for Sunday's game. He's primed for a bounce back after having a disappointing output for the team's last two games.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacob Saylors (neck/hamstring) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Jacob Saylors (neck/hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Saylors is still dealing with a couple of different injuries, but neither of them are serious at this point and he has been practicing in full all week so far. He should play in Week 10 and may see a bit more work than usual if Sione Vaki (ankle) is ruled out for the team's matchup against New England.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sione Vaki (ankle) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Sione Vaki (ankle) was not able to take part in Detroit's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Vaki wasn't able to practice on Thursday, as he's currently managing an ankle issue of some kind. He looks unlikely to play in Week 10, but his potential absence wouldn't have a significant impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: St. Brown was limited at a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still managing a rib issue of some kind, but he played through it last week and seems likely to do the same again in Week 10. Fantasy managers shouldn't be concerned with his availability for Sunday's game unless he carries an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Noah Fant (back) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Noah Fant (back) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Fant was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited by a back issue on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Week 10 but is not expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Erik McCoy (biceps) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Erik McCoy (biceps) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McCoy was a non-participant at practice on Thursday, which comes as no surprise given that he is expected to miss several weeks with an injury to his biceps. The interior of New Orleans' offensive line will be considerably worse while he's out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Taliese Fuaga (knee) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Taliese Fuaga (knee) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Fuaga is a new addition to the team's injury report, being listed with a knee issue that left him limited at practice on Thursday. It's still unclear if it will threaten his availability for Week 10, but New Orleans' offensive front will be much worse off if he's not able to suit up against the Panthers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Donaldson missed a second-straight practice on Thursday, which doesn't bode well for his availability for Week 10. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward either way with the increased work of Audric Estime and the imminent return of Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring).

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) limited Thursday
items.desc: Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Banks is still having his workload limited due to his lingering ankle issue. He was a limited participant on Thursday as a result, but he doesn't seem to be at risk of missing this week's game. He will continue to be a key part of New Orleans' offense for as long as he remains healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Kamara was held out of the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, but he made his return to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be a full go in Week 10 but will see less work than usual if Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is back in the lineup this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Etienne has been out for most of the season with a hamstring issue, but he was able to return to practice on Wednesday and was limited for another practice session on Thursday. He could be back in the lineup this week, which would kill the fantasy value of Audric Estime and Alvin Kamara ahead of a plus matchup against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Spears was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday, but he made his return on Thursday and was a limited participant. That's a good sign for his Week 10 availability, although we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Carnell Tate (shoulder) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie wasn't able to practice again on Thursday as he continues to recover from a shoulder injury. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined again in Week 10, which would likely lead to more work for Wan'Dale Robinson this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (finger/rest) did not take part in Tennessee's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was held out of Tennessee's practice on Thursday. He's now listed with a finger issue of some kind, but it was also designated as a rest day, so it's unclear if that injury is anything to be concerned about. Friday's injury report should give us more information about what his game status will be for Week 10.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Greg Van Roten (hamstring) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Greg Van Roten (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Van Roten was limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a hamstring issue of some kind. New England's offensive line will have considerably improved depth once he's fully healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Reggie Gilliam (knee) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Reggie Gilliam (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran recently had his 21-day practice window opened and was a limited participant at practice on Thursday. He should be back in the lineup within the next week or two, which should provide a nice boost to New England's running game moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returns to limited practice Thursday
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Stevenson was able to make his return to practice on Thursday and was a limited participant. Early reports indicated that he was set to miss multiple weeks with this injury, but he seems to be recovering much quicker than expected and may miss little, if any, time. This is a situation worth monitoring heading into the weekend, as he will likely see the bulk of the work in New England's backfield if he's cleared to play in time for Sunday's game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) limited Thursday
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The team has made a habit of letting Moses miss some practice to manage his foot issue, so it's unsurprising that he was limited again on Thursday. He should be available to play in Week 10, barring any last-minute setbacks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hunter Henry (foot) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Hunter Henry (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Henry was again limited on Thursday. He has been dealing with this foot issue for a little while now, but he was able to play through it last week and seems likely to do so again this week. He could be worth starting in Week 10, as this matchup against the Lions is expected to be a high-scoring affair.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown was able to take part in practice again on Thursday, though he continues to be limited due to the pair of injuries that he's managing. He will have a real shot to suit up and play, so fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health over the next couple of days.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: James Pearce Jr. (back) limited Thursday
items.desc: James Pearce Jr. (back) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Pearce was able to return to practice on Thursday, but he was still limited due to the back issue that he's managing. Atlanta's defensive front will be short staffed if he's out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) was sidelined at Atlanta's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was sidelined for another practice on Thursday due to the same hamstring issue that has been bothering him recently. It could leave him sidelined for Week 10, but that wouldn't have a big impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bobby Okereke (foot) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Bobby Okereke (foot) missed Carolina's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran linebacker wasn't able to take part in practice on Thursday, as he's still recovering from a nagging foot issue of some kind. The Panthers' defense will be worse than usual if they are without Okereke again this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Phillips is still dealing with a hamstring issue and was sidelined last week as a result, but he was able to log a limited practice on Thursday and could be back this week. Carolina's defensive front will see a significant boost if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Xavier Legette (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Legette is still working his way back from a knee issue, but he was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday and seems to be trending towards playing in Week 10. He won't be fantasy relevant if active, but his presence would still be positive news for QB Bryce Young moving forward.
